subject: Re: Kickoff: cross-dataset label harmonization — staffing + compute
body:
Hi Dmitri,

Plan:

- Kaia Wolde 50% owns the relation semantics and the hand-verification of any new pairs we add; Efe Lindqvist 40% on the joint-training experiments; Linnea Yamada 40% on the Corpus ingestion and query API.
- Good news on compute: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation — 256 accelerators for the week of 2026-06-22 — which is exactly when the joint-training validation sweep needs to run, so the schedule works backward from that week. Everything before that fits on titan-a100 best-effort (64 GPUs for the May ADE20k+COCO run).

One dependency flag: Linnea's API work assumes the relation triples stay in the released CSV format. If Corpus wants them re-modeled into the v2 label graph schema, add two weeks.

Deshawn
